name: Frictionless onboarding: working install, env-var quickstart, agent skill on the landing
objective: Make vocky's onboarding real end to end for a coding agent: ship an install path for the `vocky` CLI that actually runs from the landing page (publish to PyPI or serve a `curl | bash` installer), add the missing `VOCKY_API_TOKEN` so two environment variables are the whole agent contract alongside today's `VOCKY_BASE_URL`, publish a copyable and downloadable end-user `SKILL.md` on the landing behind a byte-parity CI gate, and correct the landing's untrue hero payload (top-level `source_product` -> nested `source.product`, and the non-existent `vk_live_` prefix). Any net-new landing section goes through a design-cowork gate; no new backend capture contract.

review.note: All 11 slices validated together: pytest 209/0, web 78/78, build warning-free, skill parity byte-identical, installer syntax clean. Six pillars landed; both deliberate departures (Section padding, ci.yml exclusions) judged sound. No-JS floor independently re-proved against a running server. Four doc versions consolidated from eight slices' notes.
